name: Alecto
title: Blade of Vengeance

skills.name: Fate's Judgment
skills.description: Dashes behind the enemy with the highest Attack, strikes them and nearby enemies 5 times, then returns to her position. While this skill is active, she is immune to debuffs.

artifacts.name: Zorval's Wing
artifacts.notes: Unique Elarite weapon artifact. When a titan uses the Fate's Judgment skill in combat, it can trigger an effect that gives bonus stats to the whole team for 9 seconds. Upgrade material: Fairy Dust (standard) + unique Elarite artifact fragments.

artifacts.name: Elarite Crown
artifacts.notes: Unique Elarite crown artifact shared among Elarite-class titans. Upgrade material: Fairy Dust (standard) + unique Elarite artifact fragments.

artifacts.name: Chthonic Attack Seal
artifacts.notes: Unique Elarite seal artifact shared among Elarite-class titans. Upgrade material: Fairy Dust (standard) + unique Elarite artifact fragments.

leveling_materials.notes: Uses the same leveling materials as regular titans: Titan Potion and Titan Skin Stones. Artifact upgrades require Fairy Dust (standard) plus unique Elarite artifact fragments obtainable mainly during Alecto's launch event.

best_team.notes: Full Fire team with Alecto beats full Water, Earth, Darkness, and Light teams 10-0 at max level. Weakness: loses 10-0 against itself on defense, and also loses to a full Fire team without Alecto.

lore: The excavations of Elarite have unearthed a power that lay dormant for centuries. Ancient might is awakened — and the first Elarite Titan now steps into the Dominion, bringing change on a truly titanic scale. Alecto wields a new unique power: she is formidable and elusive.

miscellaneous.notes: Alecto is the first titan with two elements: Elarite (the new Kingdom Mode element) and Fire. She is the first titan of the Elarite class.
